tracked_patterns.evidence: Price action compressing near the top with lower highs and higher lows forming converging boundaries.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke decisively above the local swing high near 0.935-0.940 to establish a new high near 0.945.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price established a lower low near 0.915, then rallied decisively above the prior swing high around 0.935, invalidating the previous bearish structure.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained follow-through above the broken structure level.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent shift from bullish market structure to lower highs during the pullback from the 0.945 high, indicating potential short-term bearish structure shift.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed break below the most recent significant swing low to validate bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price established a higher low near 0.915 and broke above prior swing highs around 0.935.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None; structural shift is visible on the chart.

tracked_patterns.name: Shooting Star
tracked_patterns.evidence: Candle at the 0.945 high shows a long upper wick with bearish close, indicating rejection at resistance.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Follow-through bearish candle to confirm reversal.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Large impulsive candles during the rally likely left an unfilled price imbalance between roughly 0.930 and 0.940.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price retracement into the FVG zone required to test for support.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price rejected at the 0.945 high and is declining toward the recent swing low, signaling a potential shift from bullish to bearish structure.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed break below the 0.930 swing low to validate bearish CHoCH/BOS.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Completion of right shoulder and confirmed break below neckline support.

tracked_patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent price action at the top shows a large red candle potentially engulfing the preceding green candle near the 0.945 high.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close confirmation and subsequent bearish follow-through.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation of sustained breakdown below recent intraday support around 0.930.
